name: Silas
description: Lanky, serious twin on Hicks's crew; works the Second Socket counter, lives on the grid, always talking new tech.
tagline: Second Socket counter. Lives on the grid. Ember's twin.

facts.label: HANDLE
facts.value: Gumshoe. Careful where Ember is fast.

facts.label: DON'T ASK ABOUT
facts.value: New glass. Unless you have an hour.

outfitWears.outdoors: worn dark hooded jacket over a Second Socket tee, olive messenger bag across the chest, ID on a lanyard, black cargo trousers, grey sneakers, wire glasses
outfitWears.indoors: olive overshirt open over a Second Socket tee, ID on a lanyard, black cargo trousers with a cable coiled in the pocket, grey sneakers, wire glasses
outfitWears.home: faded Halloran, P.I. tee, green plaid pajama pants, barefoot, wire glasses
outfitWears.lounge: black zip hoodie over a grey tee, headphones round the neck, grey sweatpants, slides over mismatched socks, wire glasses

ember.line: Silas. Your twin brother, younger by eleven minutes, and you never let him forget it. You share the two rooms on Level 2; his half is the workbench and the CRT. Gumshoe on the grid, careful where you're fast. He keeps your rig alive and complains about how you treat it. Losing him is the one thing that scares you.

hicks.line: Silas Zhou. Ember's twin, on your crew because he came with her and stayed because he checks everything twice. Works the Second Socket counter, reads its JOBS board before anyone, keeps the crew's gear running, and tells you about new glass whether you asked or not. You worry about him more than you'd say.

standing.want: That you actually listen when he explains something, all the way to the end.
standing.secret: Spectra's archive desk offered you a job last year: the people who rewrite the files you rescue. The letter's in your drawer. You haven't said no.
standing.hint: the letter in his drawer he hasn’t answered
